title: vaporPressureFit operation
description: Least-squares fit of measured vapour-pressure data to the Antoine form, producing the A, B and C a component record carries. Like `heatCapacityFit`, this is curation made visible: the residuals are reported beside the coefficients so the fit is judged, not just taken.

component.title: Component
component.description: The component the data belongs to; used to label the report and to compare against any already-curated correlation.

dataset.title: Measured dataset
dataset.description: Path to a self-describing dataset dict (a `columns ( { name ...; unit ...; } ... )` block plus a flat `data ( ... )` grid), relative to the case directory. Units are MANDATORY on every column.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.

evidence.description: The FIT / HELD-OUT partition (src/propertyOps/EvidencePartition.H). Each entry names a dataset and DECLARES its role; `role` has no default, and the fitter is handed only the `fit` subset. Mutually exclusive with the legacy single `dataset`.

role.description: fit = regressed against; validation = held out

identity.description: declared identity; fills in what the dataset does not state

objective.title: Objective (what the fit minimises)
objective.description: DEV.md 4c C280, C281 step 3: the same block as fitParameters, read through FitObjective. `method`: leastSquares (the op's own search in log10 P), minimax (the LARGEST relative pressure error, by Nelder-Mead from the least-squares answer) or twoStage (the DEFAULT: least squares, then minimax from that answer; both answers kept). The one residual is the pressure, relative, (P_model - P)/P (`scale { Psat relative; }`, the only scale built). The run header names the objective and says when it is the default.

outliers.title: Outliers (discarded by name)
outliers.description: DEV.md 4c C283: after the least-squares stage a fit point whose relative pressure error exceeds `maxRelativeError` (with its unit, `percent`) is discarded BY NAME (dataset DOI, T, P), published in curation.outliersDropped, and the least-squares stage repeated once on the kept points. Absent, nothing is discarded.

window.title: Fit window (points left out by name)
window.description: DEV.md 4c C367: only the fit points whose pressure lies inside [`pressureMin`, `pressureMax`] (each a number with a pressure unit: Pa, kPa, MPa, bar, mbar, atm) are fitted; the others are LEFT OUT BY NAME, counted per study in curation.windowLeftOut, and their relative error against the fitted curve is reported (diagnostics relErr_mean_leftOut_pct, relErr_max_leftOut_pct), never fitted and never hidden. `reason` is mandatory. Applied before the outlier rule. Absent, every admissible point is fitted.

reason.description: the physical reason the fit is restricted (mandatory)

acceptance.description: The acceptance band, DECLARED BEFORE the fit. `origin` is mandatory: a limit with no stated provenance cannot be told apart from one chosen after the residuals were seen.

origin.description: where the criterion came from (experimental uncertainty, literature tolerance, engineering requirement, plumbing tolerance, ...)
